author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Seventy! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Do you yearn to return to an age of exploring derelict spacecraft with your intrepid crew of Space Truckers? Does the thought of being eaten by lurking horrors or blasted by the security forces of the universes junkyard thrill you? Then COLD SALVAGE may be for you. Let's check it out!

Check out the rules HERE : https://sablebadger.itch.io/cold-salvage-core
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 070 - COLD SALVAGE by Sable Badger
